notes.title: Eggcelerate! to the Easter Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39843881/f4156bf427c1390dbfe1f237c34164460126887c.png[/img]

The Easter Bunny made a deal for you to grab Eggcelerate! and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2216320/Eggcelerate_to_the_North_Pole/]Eggcelerate! to the North Pole[/url] on Steam this Easter season. Challenge friends on the leaderboards and see if you can improve your own ranks. It is a difficult game!

notes.title: Eggcelerate! to the Tropics March 30th!
notes.content:
Climb steep mountain passes and eggsplore ancient ruins to find hidden secrets! The rainforest has multiple routes to navigate, bridges to cross rivers and magical flowers to bring out your laughter. Play each level over and over to reach the top of the leaderboards, that is, if you can even win!

[list]
[*] Punishing Difficulty (Dark Souls of Racing)
[*] Two Wheeled Vehicles for Narrowed Paths
[*] Great for Reactions and Live Streaming
[*] Collect Hidden Treasures
[/list]

[b]Try the demo and wishlist today, the game releases March 30th 2023![/b]

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.4.5
notes.content:
The Winter Eggspansion for Eggcelerate! DLC has been converted into a fully standalone version and this update cleans up the original game. If you bought the DLC you should automatically have access to Eggcelerate! to the North Pole in your Steam library.

Unfortunately you may lose achievements from the winter DLC and the winter leaderboards are reset as they move over to the new version. I did not make that decision lightly, but realize it gives you some more playtime!

In other news Eggcelerate! will be getting a new sequel this Easter with Eggcelerate! to the Tropics!

Finally there is a new Egg Drop counter on the Title Screen so you can see how many eggs you've dropped in total!!

Until later,

Enjoy

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.3.11 Release Notes
notes.content:
- Attempting to fix issue with black screen / game lock accessing Winter Eggspansion.
- If this fails, try uninstall then install again.

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.3.10 Release Notes
notes.content: Fixed issue with missing trees on Winter Eggspansion levels.

notes.title: Ghost Cars, Leaderboards and Huge a Eggspansion!
notes.content:
During development of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902100/Winter_Eggspansion_for_Eggcelerate/]Winter Eggspansion for Eggcelerate![/url] new features were added to the original game to improve your eggsperience.

Use a ghost car of your best attempts to find new lines, increase speed and improve your best time. Combine that with the new leaderboards to compare your rank in the world against your friends for the ultimate bragging rights. Can you deliver eggs the fastest?

Updated to select levels from a campaign to support more tracks from the Winter Eggspansion for Eggcelerate! and future eggspansions! Also included with the winter eggspansion:

[list]
[*] 30 Winter Tracks around the North Pole
[*] New Winter Vehicles including Snow Plows, Zamboni, Sleigh, Ice Cream Truck and more.
[*] New Obstacles and Challenges
[*] 100 Snowmen and Snowwomen to find and collect!
[*] New Achievements!
[*] Jumping over a train with the EGG on top of your car!!!
[*] New set of yolks to crack you up!
[/list]

notes.title: It’s Snow Joke to Deliver Eggs in the Winter Eggspansion Coming March 24th!
notes.content:
Eggcelerate! was updated with ghost cars to improve your best times and more new features coming soon. Also on March 24th the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902100/Winter_Eggspansion_for_Eggcelerate/]Winter Eggspansion for Eggcelerate![/url] raises the difficulty brr to a level snowman can do! Hit the slopes to deliver the Easter eggs while drifting around snow banks and not dropping an egg.

The temperature has dropped, and so has the friction! Hit the slopes with new jumps and treacherous winter conditions to deliver your carton of eggs!

[h2]Coming March 24th[/h2]

While waiting for March 24th to come, feel free to drop by and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/timbeaudet]watch the development process live[/url], ask questions and interact with the developer of Eggcelerate! What ideas would you like to see in the game?
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1902100/Winter_Eggspansion_for_Eggcelerate/]Wishlist the Winter Eggspansion for Eggcelerate![/url] now to be among the first delivering eggs on the north pole!

notes.title: Eggcelerate! v1.1.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
- Attempted fix of saving/loading issue causing game to relock itself.
- Fixed an issue with one of the hidden achievements.
- Added a few anticut areas to block off cutting the corners in 11, 14, 30
- Added colliders for some objects in level 30.
- Updated the developer times, this should be final times for these levels.
- Actual fix for time <= devTime as there were still issues in v1.1.1
- Fixed icon for dev time so it shows if the achievement was collected.
- Level select now remembers the last level played.
- Fixed issue with victory jumping to retry/exit after finish and still turning.
- Fixed an issue with Keep it Alive.
- Always show Keep it Alive icon in level 1.
- Fixed some pixel-noise on the Keep it Alive HUD icon.
- Added icons on Level Select to show there are more than 15 levels.
- Moved start line to ensure the timer restarts on reset on Track 25.
- Fixed unreported issue in the Credits scene.
- Fixing an issue that may have invoked achievement or saving issues.
- Fixed a hidden achievement.

notes.title: Addressing Some Issues in v1.1.1
notes.content:
- Added pink and purple bunny bowls for Easter.
- Fixed steam achievements for 6 eggs, developer times and 1000 eggs dropped.
- Fixed in game achievement notification showing when the steam notification shows.
- Fixed small holes in the jump gap on Track 10.
- Fixed issue with spoon bowl sizing, it was hard to judge top of bowl.
- Fixed floor on the bus/van and peach RV rear door color.
- Fixed issue where RV and chicken-bowl were clipping on the Car Setup Screen.
- Fixed usability with cursor vs gamepad vs keyboard on some of the UI elements.
- Fixed issue where cursor would sit on a button and not highlight while moving.
- Added planks and haybales to direct focus into a windmill.
- Fixed stretched and moving textures on downhill levels.
- Fixed an issue where one of the hidden achievements was giving a different achievement ID.
- Fixed some cheesy "cuts".
- Fixed fade-out from the music that made the loop noticeable.
- Added a small egg to show when Keep it Alive is still valid in a run.
- Fixed issue with settings and paused screens on very wide displays.

notes.title: Are You Fast Enough to Deliver Eggs for the Easter Bunny? Try now for 25% off!
notes.content:
Drive as fast you can to deliver eggs for the Easter bunny without breaking them! Watch out for devious obstacles that will crush you, punch you and make you throw your hands up in a fit of rage. Eggcelerate! is a time-trial racing game that just released today, grab your copy now and get [b]25% off![/b]

[previewyoutube=iQRzaWqbjEc;full][/previewyoutube]
Don’t be deceived by the cute and fluffy art style, there are teeth behind that smile! You will laugh, cry and scream at the difficulty of protecting your egg. Overcome the challenges of each track to unlock new [b]cars[/b], [b]eggs[/b] and [b]bowls[/b]. Discover your favorite combinations and which egg is lucky for you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39843881/153b7776779d8cc6983aacd3e5044205d4f06c6a.png[/img]

Find hidden achievements throughout the game and attempt the most prestigious achievement ever; consecutively completing all [b]30 tracks[/b] without dropping a [i]single[/i] egg!
Grab [b]Eggcelerate! now for 25% off[/b] and start delivering eggs for the Easter bunny!

[h2]Game Features[/h2]

[b]Devious Obstacle Courses[/b]
Jumps, hammers, punching gloves, fallen trees, saws and more will get in the way of safely delivering your egg this Easter!

[b]Customize Your Ride[/b]
Discover your favorite car, egg and bowl combinations whilst overcoming the challenges of each track to unlock the new options.

[b]Master Your Racing Skills[/b]
Delivering an Easter egg requires smooth driving to keep the egg safe and balanced. This is a useful skill for driving a real racecar at the limit too!

[b]Keep it Alive[/b]
The most prestigious achievement ever; consecutively completing all 30 tracks without dropping a single egg!

[b]Perfect for Live Streaming[/b]
Game was designed for streamer reactions and your audience will laugh and feel your pain as you try again and again!

[b]Warning:[/b] Food Allergy*, may contain egg products.
[i]This game is not actually edible.[/i]

notes.title: Drive a Racecar to Deliver Eggs for the Bunny this Easter! Releasing March 30th!
notes.content:

A challenging time-trial racing game where you try again and again to deliver eggs for Easter. Laugh, cry and shout in joy while trying to improve your time without dropping your egg against devious and hilarious obstacles.

Wishlist it now, play on March 30th!
